map.name: Frostvault Chambers
map.description: Each defender holds a sealed square against waves that circle a central keep.

text.objectives: Stop the waves from reaching the western exit and defeat the final boss. Shared lives are limited.
briefing: Each player defends a separate island chamber. Enemies circle its outer lane; ranged defenses on the island attack through the thin wall.
An enemy at your Exit removes one shared life. The team loses when no shared lives remain.
Your Civilian buys the units or support shown beside your beacons. The entrance icon is your mobile recruitment token.
The final boss spawns in each active chamber. Defeat the boss in your own chamber to win.

messages.intro: Frostvault: stop {waves} waves. The team shares {lives} lives.
messages.objectives: Block {waves} waves and kill the final boss before the shared lives reach zero.
messages.boss: The end boss appears in active chambers: {unit}.
messages.leak: An enemy escaped your chamber; one team life was lost.
messages.defeat: The team has no shared lives remaining.
messages.win: Your chamber boss is defeated. You hold Frostvault.
messages.respawn: A reserve squad has reached the center island.
messages.wave_clear: Your chamber is clear. Replenish before the next wave.
messages.clear_arena: The chamber is clear. Your team earns ore for the next wave.
